question: Does the end state (every Dimension reachable for both bot colours + a safe fallback) already exist anywhere, and does completing the book collide with anything that depends on the current asymmetry?
evidence: selectOpening already filters by botColor and weights by targets===weakest, but the DATA can't satisfy the weighting for uncovered (colour, dimension) pairs — so the intended end state (steering works for both colours) is NOT reached today.

steeringNote returns the non-steering 'Playing the X.' wording whenever the chosen opening.targets !== weakest, which is exactly what happens on a silent no-op — so the user-facing symptom is already wired; only the DATA + an explicit no-coverage path are missing.

silent_no_op_demonstrated.result: every pick returned a non-tactics Black line (ruylopez-b/scandi-b/philidor-b/caro-b); weighting collapsed to uniform because the weight-3 set was empty; steeringNote emitted 'Playing the X.' (no steering) for all picks
silent_no_op_demonstrated.conclusion: Steering for tactics (and endgameConversion) is a SILENT no-op when the bot is Black today. Same for resilience when the bot is White. Confirmed by simulation.

tests.src/opening/openingBook.test.ts: Adding lines does NOT break existing tests: legality test iterates all lines (new lines validated legal); 'covers both colours + all 5 dims' tests the UNION and still passes; selectOpening colour/bias/variety tests use bot='w' tactics (unaffected); nextBookMove uses italian-w/scandi-b by id (unaffected); steeringNote uses italian-w (unaffected). The ~3:1 variety test asserts otherPicks>0 — still true after additions. NO existing assertion contradicts the new rows.
tests.risk: LOW. New per-colour-coverage assertions are ADDED, not modifying existing ones.

After the PR the pool is never empty for a real colour, but the colour-agnostic fallback (Q-A) should return a same-colour entry to make a future gap fail safe, not silently no-op.
